answer: I would stop farms with email domain ownership proof, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 604 aliases would need 604 separate proofs, each costing about 104 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The relic test is the live device, the jade test is the locked stake, and the glacier test is the graded history no template can fake. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
